God instructs Moses: 'Speak now in the ears of the people, and let them ask each man from his neighbor' (דַּבֶּר־ נָ֖א בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיִשְׁאֲל֞וּ...), explicitly encouraging them to make requests. Furthermore, Pharaoh acknowledges their expressed wishes, saying 'go serve the LORD as you have said' (כְּדַבַּרְכֶֽם), indicating their views were heard and respected. The Israelites are shown actively communicating with Egyptians and successfully making their positions known.
